feature: Idle host polling and remote application controls

automated.environment: Full suite rerun outside the filesystem/network sandbox after its local TLS listener and system image decoding were blocked. Hardware tests were disabled.

verified: Paired host library loads and displays Resume on its running Desktop app
Running Desktop context menu contains Resume and Quit Remote Application
Quit confirmation identifies Desktop; Cancel preserves the running session
Selecting Balatro while Desktop runs offers Quit Desktop and start Balatro with Quit and Start and Cancel actions
Switch confirmation layout is readable; Cancel preserves the running session
Computer ellipsis menu no longer contains Quit Remote Application
not_exercised: Confirmed quit-and-start against the real host, including media playback in the replacement app
Timed five-second polling cadence and externally initiated running-app changes on the real host
live_ui.note: The existing remote Desktop session was left running. Protocol ordering, quit failure, changed confirmations, stale polling, automatic banner updates, and lifecycle pauses are covered by the regression fixtures.
